{"test_name": "test_post_orders_idempotency_2", "code": "def test_post_orders_idempotency_2(client, auth):
    product_id = next(p["id"] for p in client.get("/products", headers=auth["customer"]).json() if p["active"])
    headers = {**auth["customer"], "Idempotency-Key": f"agentqa-{uuid.uuid4()}"}
    first = client.post("/orders", json={"items": [{"product_id": product_id, "quantity": 1}]}, headers=headers)
    second = client.post("/orders", json={"items": [{"product_id": product_id, "quantity": 1}]}, headers=headers)
    assert first.status_code == 201, first.text
    assert second.status_code == 200, f"replay returned {second.status_code}"
    assert second.json()["id"] == first.json()["id"], "a duplicate order was created"
